Title: Azure Migrate is now available in Azure Government

Body.Content:
All Azure Migrate features, including agentless discovery and assessment, application inventory, and migration, are now available in Azure Government. Azure Migrate provides a hub of Microsoft and partner tools to help customers meet their migration needs. Azure Migrate also offers scenarios for database migration, VDI migration, and web application migration, in addition to at-scale migration of VMware, Hyper-V, and physical servers to Azure.

See the supported geographies for Azure Government.
